snippet.title: Grow a Girlfriend - Visual Novel Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST AND PLAY THE FREE DEMO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766830/Grow_a_Girlfriend/

Trailer edited by Randi Mathivha and myself.

I have worked on this game for the past 2 years and I am elated to announce that Grow a Girlfriend is coming out in late 2025! I put so much time and energy into this, so every wishlist means a lot to me. Enjoy playing the latest demo, which willl give you a "taste" of what is soon to come!

🎁 Support the dev on Patreon and receive game news and BTS info: https://www.patreon.com/c/trubluIs
🗣️ Follow the developer: https://twitter.com/trubluIs
